name: Home Chef Manufacturing & Distribution Center Baltimore MD

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus-style entrance off E Patapsco Ave; Street View (2024-06) shows no barrier arm, swing/sliding gate, or pinch-point across the truck drive. Shared Harbor Logistics Center park, no perimeter fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance in Street View or satellite.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved aprons and an uncontrolled multi-lane park drive leave ample room to add a controlled bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long marked trailer-drop row (~30 stalls) along the SW (river) perimeter drive, plus apron parking; counted from z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~35 doors along the building's SW face with trailers backed in; overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Home Chef leases one of three matching warehouses in the Harbor Logistics Center; only the Home Chef building (center/west) is geofenced here.
fieldNotes.railServed: CSX/rail lines run west across the Patapsco River; no spur enters this property.
